places-covetes-del-puntal-abric-iv-els-c.story: 68 km from Albocàsser to Albocàsser, about 1 h 10 of riding. It goes by way of Racó d'en Gil, Els Covarxos and back through Racó d'en Gil. The highest point is about 1,250 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
